purpose: Amateur astronomy as location- and time-specific observation using documented instruments, sky conditions, calibration, logs, and shared data protocols.
editorial_principles: Use a named jurisdiction, population, and date where applicable.
Present comparisons on equal terms and label illustrative scenarios.
Verify primary sources and current guidance before production.
Name date, location, instrument, target, and uncertainty. Never point unfiltered optics at the Sun; distinguish observed light from inferred physical cause or discovery claim.
